sqlMap.select: SELECT wb.orderid, count(wb.idx) as cnt, SUM(IF(wp.prd_type ='point',1,0)) as point_cnt FROM wiz_order as wo LEFT JOIN wiz_basket as wb On wb.orderid = wo.orderid LEFT JOIN wiz_product as wp On wp.prdcode = wb.prdcode WHERE 1 = 1 and wo.orderid = #ORDER_NO# GROUP BY wb.orderid HAVING point_cnt = cnt
